scope: Gate 2C exploratory non-oracle fixed search and actual cumulative work caps; no adaptive method
signal_seed_rule: 3000000000 + message_index*100000 + snr_index*10000 + trial_index; same seed across five drifts
pure_noise_seed_rule: 3100000000 + snr_index*10000 + trial_index, snr_index 0..1, trial_index 0..99; noise variance as if unit-power signal at indicated SNR

multi_spec.each_nominal_snr_2500_db: same cell SNR; individual active power 1, equal powers

noise_convention: random.Random(seed), Gaussian per component sigma=sqrt((375/2500)*10**(-snr/10)/2), frame 45000 IQ 375Hz; C2 stores I,-Q float32
generator: existing wspr.encoder type1, waveform, wsprd symbolwise drift and noise; all versions hashed
grid: 0,+0.5,-0.5,+1,-1 Hz as Gate2B, B2 score ordering, B3 zero-first
arms: A0 production plus instrumented A0 reference; B2 and B3 existing Gate 2B. A1 excluded: earlier cells showed less recovery and substantially higher cost, limited exploratory resources; not a claim of universal inferiority.
budget_definition: per input, exact Fano main-loop iterations summed across all calls and candidates; increment coarse-search hypothesis, sync call and block-demod call before operation. Stop before a counter would exceed its cap. Fano cap can interrupt a call; retain all prior validated decodes. Same accounting and cap levels on A0, B2, B3. Coarse FFTs and subtraction not converted to Fano iterations; record CPU and time separately.
validation: unlimited budget builds reproduce deterministic stdout, stderr, result files against actual original binaries, clean and saved inputs; budget builds use no known payload or drift; Parser V2 parses messages, evaluation checks expected sets afterwards. For multi, unexpected = output not in either target; duplicates assessed from decoded messages and raw trace.
inference: per cell n=40 independent seeds; shared noise across drift; per-cell Wilson intervals; paired gain/loss intervals; no pooling as independent; null signal Wilson n=200 and separately by noise level; screening only
provenance_note: Public copy of frozen settings; path- and host-specific metadata removed. Generous equivalence instrumentation was resumed with all work-counter caps disabled after the documented stop. Low and medium budgets remain unchanged.
